name: Park Seo-joon
bio:
Park Seo-joon's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While pursuing a degree in mechanical engineering at KAIST, a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion that would reshape his career. He started as a data analyst, quickly proving his aptitude for deciphering complex telemetry and translating it into tangible performance gains. After graduation, he took a position with a smaller Formula team where he spent years honing his skills. 

Seo-joon is known for his meticulous approach and ability to identify innovative solutions under pressure. He emphasizes a collaborative relationship with the driver, believing that open communication is crucial for optimizing car setup and race strategy. He is now a competent and experienced race engineer at Carlin where he is valued for his calm demeanor and pragmatic approach.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Park is of medium build, with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks exactly two cups of green tea before each race.
